input.quote: 19.2 For ninety days after delivery or acceptance, whichever is later, each Deliverable will materially conform to its documentation and acceptance criteria. Hosted Services will conform throughout the subscription term. Vendor warrants it has authority to enter the Agreement and grant the rights stated here.
input.rationale: Compliant at the preferred position; no redline proposed. Duration: § 19.2 (p0077) states the Deliverable conformance period as "ninety days after delivery or acceptance, whichever is later" — the period is spelled out in words rather than numerals, which is why an automated ">= 90 days / months / years" pattern check did not fire. Substantively the period is 90 days measured from the later of delivery or acceptance, so it meets (and by the measuring date slightly exceeds) the preferred 90-day services/deliverables benchmark, and hosted Services must "conform throughout the subscription term", which exceeds the 12-month software benchmark. Substance: § 19.1 (p0076) gives the professional and workmanlike warranty by qualified personnel per industry standards plus material conformance of Services and Deliverables to documentation and agreed specifications; § 19.3 (p0078) gives no-malicious-code and compliance-with-Applicable-Law warranties; § 19.4 (p0079) gives the full remedy ladder of prompt re-performance, repair or replacement at no charge, then termination of the affected item and refund of Fees paid, expressly non-exclusive for fraud, infringement, confidentiality, privacy, security and indemnified claims. Disclaimer: § 19.5 (p0080) is confined to implied warranties and expressly provides that no disclaimer limits an express warranty, service level, indemnity or stated remedy, so it does not swallow the express warranties and there is no "AS IS" walk-away risk. No material term fails the preferred or fallback position.
